name: paperless
description: Paperless-ngx (Postgres/MariaDB + Redis): DB auto-detection dumps the SQL DB; the Redis broker gets a BGSAVE checkpoint via the built-in quiesce (queue only - losing it is harmless). media/ (originals + archive PDFs) is the irreplaceable part and lives in the stack folder/volumes. data/index and the classifier model are regenerable ('document_index reindex' / retraining) but small, so they stay in the backup. Alternative portable export: 'document_exporter' as a pre-hook - not needed for a same-version restore. If the stack runs the postgres-backup-local sidecar, its rotating dump folder (./pgbackups) is excluded - docker-backup takes its own consistent dump. postgres:18+ mounts /var/lib/postgresql (parent layout); the raw data dir is excluded there as well - the dump replaces it.
